items.text: The Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine was awarded to US researchers Victor Ambros and Gary Ruvkun for discovering microRNA. They will share nearly a million euros. MicroRNA is a class of small molecules that play a vital role in regulating how genes are expressed, influencing the development of different types of cells in the body, such as muscles, neurons, and heart cells. Their discovery was made in the 1990s and initially focused on a worm species. However, by 2000, it was found that microRNA is also essential in humans. Although the award recognizes basic scientific research, there are no direct medical applications for it yet. The discovery is considered a significant advancement in understanding how genes are translated into proteins, but more research is needed to uncover its future benefits. Difficult words: vital (necessary, essential), application (putting something into use or operation), advancement (development or improvement). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

The 2024 Nobel Prize for Medicine went to US researchers Victor Ambros and Gary Ruvkun. They won nearly a million euros for discovering microRNA, a tiny molecule which helps control how genes work. This research is important because it helps explain how different cells, like muscles, neurons, and heart cells, develop from the same DNA. At first, scientists found microRNA in worms, but later, they learned it is also important in humans. The award is for basic science, so there are no clear uses in medicine right now. The discovery helps scientists understand better how genes turn into proteins, which may be useful in the future. Difficult words: tiny (very small), gene (a part of the DNA which controls how the body grows), discovery (finding something new). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

US scientists Victor Ambros and Gary Ruvkun win the 2024 Nobel Prize for Medicine. They find out about microRNA. MicroRNA is a very small molecule. It helps control how genes work in the body. Genes tell the body how to make your muscles, heart, and brain. At first, the two men find microRNA in worms . Later, they see that it is important for people too. Their discovery helps scientists to learn more about how the body works. Medicine cannot use the discovery yet. But it may help in the future. Difficult words: molecule (a very small part of something), worm (a small animal with a soft body without arms, legs, or bones), discovery (finding something new). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

China has introduced temporary anti-dumping measures on brandy imports from the EU, especially affecting famous French brands like Hennessy and Remy Martin. This comes after the EU voted to impose tariffs on Chinese-made electric vehicles (EVs). According to China’s commerce ministry, EU brandy imports have harmed Chinas domestic industry. France criticized the move, calling it unfair and against free trade principles, and plans to work with the European Commission to challenge it at the World Trade Organization. Additionally, China announced it is reviewing potential tariff increases on large-engine vehicles, which would heavily impact German manufacturers. These actions are seen as part of growing trade tensions between China and the EU, particularly targeting France, which has supported the new EV tariffs. Difficult words: anti-dumping (preventing cheap foreign goods from harming local businesses), challenge (to call to prove or justify something), tariff (a tax or duty to be paid on a particular class of imports or exports). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

China decided to add temporary rules on brandy imports from the EU. This decision mainly affects French brands like Hennessy. This happened after the EU decided to put tariffs on Chinese electric cars. China’s government says that importing brandy from the EU hurts its local industry. France says these rules are unfair and will work with the European Commission to solve the problem. China is also considering increasing taxes on large cars, which could affect German car companies. These new rules show that the trade fight between China and the EU is getting worse, especially between China and France. Difficult words: temporary (lasting for only some time), import (products from another country), tariff (a tax on things from other countries). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

China is making new rules for brandy from the EU, especially brands from France like Hennessy. This happens when the EU decides to put new taxes on electric cars from China. China says that brandy from the EU is hurting its brandy makers. France thinks that these new rules are not fair. France wants to work with the EU to solve the problem. China is also thinking about putting more taxes on big cars from Germany. Last year, German car companies sell many cars with large engines to China. These changes show that China and the EU are having problems with business. The situation is getting worse, mainly with France and Germany. Difficult words: rule (what you can or cannot do), tax (money which people and companies pay to the government), engine (a machine which turns energy into movement). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Thousands of protesters gathered in Budapest outside the offices of Hungary’s public media corporation, MTVA, to demand greater press freedom. The protest, organized by opposition leader Péter Magyar of the TISZA party, was directed against what critics call a ‘propaganda factory’ that serves the government. Magyar, who leads the most significant opposition to Prime Minister Viktor Orbán, said the public media spreads lies and distorts the truth. His party received nearly 30% of the vote in recent EU elections and is growing in popularity. Media watchdogs claim that Orbán’s party controls 80% of Hungary’s media market, threatening press freedom. Protesters like Balázs Tömpe and Ágnes Gera expressed anger over media bias and censorship. Magyar called for the resignation of the public media director and urged people to attend another protest on October 23 to continue the fight for media reform. Difficult words: distort (to give misleading or false information or impression), watchdog (an organization that guards against loss, theft, or undesirable practices), bias (supporting or opposing a particular person or thing unfairly). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

In Budapest, many people protested outside the office of Hungary’s public media , MTVA. They want more freedom for the press. Péter Magyar, the leader of the TISZA party, organized the protest. He said the public media only shows what the government wants and tells lies. Magyar’s party is the main opposition to Prime Minister Viktor Orbán, and it got almost 30% of the vote in the recent EU elections. Reporters Without Borders said the government controls 80% of Hungary’s media. Protesters like Balázs Tömpe and Ágnes Gera believe the media is unfair and doesn’t show all sides. Magyar asked the director of public media to quit and called for another protest on October 23. Difficult words: media (the internet, magazines, TV, and so on), opposition (a group against those in power), quit (to leave a position, or to stop doing something). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

People in Budapest protest. They want the press to be free. Péter Magyar is the leader of the TISZA party. He organizes the protest. He says the public media only shows what the government wants and tells lies. His party is getting stronger. They win 30% of the vote in the last elections. Reporters Without Borders says that the government controls most of the media in Hungary. Some people, like Balázs Tömpe and Ágnes Gera, are angry. They believe that the media does not show different opinions . Magyar asks the director of public media to leave his job. He asks people to join another protest on October 23. Difficult words: media (TV, radio, internet, and so on), opinion (what someone thinks or feels), join (to take part). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

After over fifty years, the UK is returning the sovereignty of the Chagos Islands to Mauritius, following a historic agreement. Located in the Indian Ocean, Hagos Islands include Diego Garcia, a crucial US military base. The UK had kept control since Mauritius gained independence in 1968, even evicting over 1,000 residents to create the military base. The dispute lasted for years, going through courts and international bodies like the UN. Increasing pressure from these institutions and declining support, especially after Brexit, pushed the UK to negotiate the handover. Although Mauritius will control the islands, the US will continue using the base for 99 years. The evicted Chagossians may return, though living conditions on the islands are difficult. The deal is seen as a victory for anti-colonial movements and international law. Difficult words: sovereignty (the power to govern a country or area), evict (to force people to leave a place), dispute (a disagreement or argument). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

The UK decided to give back the Chagos Islands to Mauritius after controlling them for over 50 years. These islands are in the Indian Ocean, and one of them, Diego Garcia, is important because the US uses it as a military base . The UK kept the islands after Mauritius became independent in 1968 and even made people leave the islands to build the base. The United Nations and other international groups wanted the UK to return the islands, and the pressure on the UK increased even more after Brexit. The deal allows the US to use the base for 99 more years. The people who had to leave the islands will now be able to return, but living conditions on the islands are difficult. Difficult words: military base (a place where soldiers or the army stay), pressure (force), living conditions (the situation in which people live). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

The UK is giving the Chagos Islands back to Mauritius after more than 50 years. The Chagos Islands are a group of islands in the Indian Ocean. One of these islands is called Diego Garcia. It is very important. The US has a military base there. In 1968, Mauritius becomes free from British control. But the UK keeps the Chagos Islands. The US wants to use Diego Garcia for the base. The UK makes more than 1,000 people leave their homes. Now, the UK will return the islands to Mauritius. The US can still use the base for the next 99 years. Also, people can return to the islands. But living there will be difficult. Difficult words: military base (a place where soldiers stay), return (to give back). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Spain’s first transgender soccer team has made its debut in a regional men’s league in Catalonia, a significant achievement in sports. Fenix FC consists entirely of transgender men and had previously only played friendly matches. Now, they are competing in the fifth division of a Catalan regional league after overcoming various administrative challenges to gain federated status. This is particularly important given the rise of transphobia , with 302 reported cases of violence or discrimination against LGBT individuals in Catalonia in 2023. Hugo Martinez, the team’s founder, started Fenix FC to provide a safe space for trans men to play soccer, inspired by his own negative experiences while transitioning. Although their first official match ended in a heavy 19-0 loss, the players emphasized that their right to play and feel safe is more important than winning. The Catalan Football Association confirmed that all players, regardless of gender, can participate in men’s leagues. Difficult words: debut (the first appearance), federated (set up as a single centralized unit), transphobia (fear or hate against transgender people). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Spain’s first transgender soccer team, Fenix FC, played its first game in a regional men’s league. The team consists only of transgender men. They played friendly games before, but now they are part of the fifth division in Catalonia. This is important because transgender people still face a lot of discrimination . In 2023, there were 302 cases of violence or discrimination against LGBT people in Catalonia, many of them aimed at transgender people. Hugo Martinez, the team’s creator, had a hard time when he started his gender change. It made him want to create a safe place for trans men to play soccer. The team’s first official match ended with a 19-0 loss, but the players are more focused on being able to play freely. The Catalan Football Association said players of any gender can join men’s leagues. Difficult words: transgender (someone whose gender doesn’t match their birth gender), discrimination (unfair treatment), aim (to point or direct at a target). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Fenix FC is a soccer team. There are only transgender men in it. The team plays its first game in Spain. It is the first all-trans team in a men’s league . The team plays in a league in Catalonia. They play friendly games before, but now they are part of a real league. Transgender people in Spain still have many problems. In 2023, there are many attacks on them. Hugo Martinez makes the team. He wants a safe place for trans men to play. He has a hard time when he starts changing his gender . The team loses their first game 19-0, but the players say that playing together is more important than winning. Difficult words: transgender (a person who is born as a man but feels like a woman, or the other way round), league (a group of sports clubs which play each other), gender (the male or female sex). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

In Australia’s Northern Territory, a course teaches students how to handle encounters with snakes, including dangerous ones like pythons and venomous king brown snakes. The key lesson is to stay calm because snakes usually don’t want to harm humans. Former park ranger Johnny McGannon who leads the course explains that people no longer need to act recklessly around snakes, like pulling their tails. About thirty students from various fields, like military personnel and zoo workers, have completed this certified training since the beginning of the year. However, not everyone agrees with this method. Rex Narf, who runs a reptile center in Alice Springs, has caught snakes for years and feels that experience is more valuable than a formal course. Despite these differences, McGannon emphasizes that all snake educators share the same goal: teaching people to respect and behave safely around snakes, which helps protect both humans and these often misunderstood creatures. Difficult words: encounter (an unexpected meeting), recklessly (without care or thinking of danger), reptile (an animal such as a snake, lizard, or crocodile). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

A new course in Australia’s Northern Territory teaches students how to stay calm when they meet snakes, even dangerous ones like king brown snakes and pythons. Johnny McGannon is a former park ranger and he says that snakes usually don’t want to attack people. Students learn to stay safe around snakes without doing risky things like grabbing their tails. Since the start of the year, about thirty students from different jobs, like military workers and zoo staff, completed the course. Some people, like Rex Narf who has caught snakes for years, believe that experience is more important than training. But McGannon says all trainers have the same goal : helping people learn to stay safe and protect both snakes and humans. Difficult words: python (a very large snake which kills animals for food by wrapping itself around them), grab (to catch something or someone with the hand suddenly and roughly), goal (something you want to reach or achieve). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

In Australia’s Northern Territory, there is a special course. It teaches people what to do when they see a snake. Johnny McGannon is a teacher. He says that snakes do not usually want to hurt people. Students learn to be safe around snakes, even very dangerous ones like pythons and king brown snakes. Thirty people finish the course this year. They are workers from different jobs like the military and zoos. Some people think it is better to learn from experience . You will learn more than in a class. But Johnny says that teaching people helps both snakes and people stay safe. Difficult words: python (a very large snake which kills animals), military (people who work for the army), experience (learning from doing something). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Mexico has a new president, Claudia Sheinbaum, its first-ever female leader. She was sworn in during a ceremony in Mexico City and has pledged to continue the policies of her predecessor , Andrés Manuel López Obrador. Sheinbaum won a landslide victory earlier this year, but now faces several challenges in office. One of the most significant problems is the country’s ongoing gang violence, which has caused insecurity for many citizens. Sheinbaum has been involved in politics for years and was the mayor of Mexico City, where she managed several crises, including a train crash in 2021. She reduced the city’s murder rate but couldn’t stop the rise in missing people. As president, she must also deal with a high budget deficit , which she has promised to cut in half while maintaining her predecessor’s expensive social welfare programs. Difficult words: predecessor (a person who held the job or office before the current holder), deficit (the amount by which something is too small), welfare (the health and happiness of a person or group). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Claudia Sheinbaum is Mexico’s new president. She is the first woman to have this job. There was a ceremony in Mexico City. Scheinbaum said she wants to continue the plans of the president before her, Andrés Manuel López Obrador. She won the election easily but has some big problems to solve. One of these problems is gang violence , which makes life dangerous for people. Before she became president, Sheinbaum was the mayor of Mexico City. She helped lower the number of murders but couldn’t stop the increase in people who went missing. Now, she will also try to reduce Mexico’s budget deficit but keep popular social programs at the same time. Difficult words: gang violence (actions by a group of people meant to hurt others), mayor (the leader of a city), deficit (the amount by which something is too small). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Claudia Sheinbaum is the new president of Mexico. She is the first woman to be president. She has a big ceremony in Mexico City. She says that she will keep the plans of the president before her, Andrés Manuel López Obrador. But Sheinbaum has some big problems to solve. One problem is gang violence . People in Mexico do not feel safe because of that. Before, she is the mayor of Mexico City. She helps lower the number of murders. But more people go missing. Now, as president, she will also try to solve the country’s problem with money. It will be a difficult task. Difficult words: ceremony (a formal event), gang violence (when a group of people hurts others), mayor (the leader of a city). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Since the beginning of the full-scale invasion of Ukraine, hundreds of thousands of Russians are estimated to have left their country. In September 2022, President Putin announced a military mobilization . Though the government called it partial, in reality, it meant that most men could be drafted to fight in the war. As a result, many families fled the country, causing long waits at the borders with Georgia and Kazakhstan. Some who left are outspoken critics of the Kremlin, fearing they could be targeted next. Alexei Navalny, a well-known opposition leader, died under suspicious circumstances, and many believe he was poisoned by the Russian state, highlighting the risks dissidents face. Difficult words: mobilization (preparing and organizing troops for active service), outspoken (expressing strong opinions very directly), dissident (a person who strongly disagrees and publicly criticizes a government). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Since the war in Ukraine started, many Russians left their country. Experts estimate that hundreds of thousands of people left, especially after President Putin’s announcement in September 2022. Putin called for more men to join the military, meaning almost all men would have to fight if the government asked them to. This led to long lines at the borders of Russia, especially with Georgia and Kazakhstan, as families tried to run away. Many people who left fear their safety because the Russian government silences people who openly speak against it. For example, Alexei Navalny, an opposition leader, died, and some people believe the government killed him. Difficult words: estimate (to guess or calculate the cost, size, number, and so on), announcement (a formal statement in front of many people), silence (to make someone stay quiet). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Since the start of Russia’s invasion of Ukraine, many Russians leave their country. Hundreds of thousands of people leave. Men are scared that they will have to fight in the war. In September 2022, President Putin says that the army needs more men. It means that most men must go and fight if the government says so. This causes long lines at Russia’s borders. Many people want to leave for places like Georgia and Kazakhstan. Many people who leave Russia also worry about safety . Some Russian leaders who oppose Putin, like Alexei Navalny, die. Many people think that Putin kills them. Difficult words: invasion (when an army or country comes and wants to control another country), safety (a safe situation or place), oppose (to speak against someone). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

On Tuesday, Iran launched missiles toward Israel. Air raid sirens went off across the country, and people were told to stay near bomb shelters. Alerts were sent to mobile phones and announced on TV. Some of the alarms were heard in places like Jerusalem and central Israel. Earlier, rockets were also fired from Lebanon. In answer, Israel started some ground operations in southern Lebanon. Israeli forces targeted villages in the south of Lebanon, from where people were told to evacuate. Hezbollah militants retaliated by launching many rockets at Israel. As the fighting intensified, there were no immediate reports of casualties; however, the situation raised concerns that the conflict might spread into a regional war. Israel and the United States had previously warned that there would be severe consequences if Iran attacked. Difficult words: air raid siren (a device that sounds an alarm to warn people of danger), retaliate (to fight back or respond with an attack), consequence (a result or effect, usually one that is unwelcome or unpleasant). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

On Tuesday, Iran fired missiles at Israel. People could hear sirens, and they got messages on their phones telling them to stay near bomb shelters. The day before, Lebanon fired some rockets at Israel, so Israel started to fight back on the ground in southern Lebanon. Israel attacked some villages in Lebanon, and people there had to evacuate . A group called Hezbollah in Lebanon fired more rockets at Israel. The conflict got worse, and people started to worry that it could turn into a war. There were no reports of people getting hurt right away, but Israel and the United States said that if Iran attacked Israel, they would respond to the attack. Difficult words: missile (a weapon which travels in the air and hits a place), siren (a device which makes a loud warning noise), evacuate (to leave a place because it is dangerous to stay). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

On Tuesday, Iran attacks Israel. People can hear loud sirens. Sirens warn people that something dangerous can happen. People have to stay in safe places. Before this, rockets come from Lebanon. So Israel starts fighting back on the ground in southern Lebanon. Israel attacks villages in Lebanon. People have to leave. A group called Hezbollah in Lebanon shoots more rockets at Israel. The fighting is getting worse. People are worried a bigger war could start. Israel and the United States say that if Iran attacks Israel, they will respond to the attack. Difficult words: warn (to say that something bad may happen), village (a group of houses and buildings which is smaller than a town), respond (to answer). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Malaysia, a major producer of durian, is expected to benefit significantly from an agreement with China to import fresh durian. After a visit from the Chinese Premier, China agreed to accept the fruit, which is considered a delicacy , especially in China. The harvesting of durian occurs early in the morning, as timing is crucial . If the fruits drop, their quality can suffer. Penang Island provides excellent conditions for this fruit, with various high-quality types thriving there. Although Malaysia represents only 10% of global durian exports, its focus on premium-quality durians allows it to be a significant player in this profitable market. Growers carefully track the origin of each durian to ensure quality for Chinese customers. The owner of one farm, who refuses to sell despite offers, expresses pride in the fruit. He plans to breed new varieties, make the farm organic, and attract tourists to experience the unique durian harvest. Difficult words: delicacy (rare and expensive food), crucial (necessary), thrive (to grow and develop well). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Malaysia produces a lot of durian, a fruit with a strong smell. The country will earn more money now that China will import fresh durian. After a visit from the Chinese Premier, China agreed to accept this fruit, which many Chinese people consider a delicacy . The best time to harvest durians is early morning because they can fall if farmers don’t pick them quickly. Penang Island is great for growing durian; many high-quality types of durian grow there. Malaysia is only 10% of the world’s durian exports but focuses on high-quality types. Farmers track each fruit’s origin to ensure quality for China. One farmer plans to keep his land and hopes to grow new types of durian and open his farm to tourists. Difficult words: delicacy (special food which is very tasty), exports (things which a country sends to another country for sale), ensure (to make sure that something will happen). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Durian is a fruit with a strong smell. Malaysia grows a lot of durian. China will buy fresh durians from Malaysia now. After a visit from the Chinese leader, the country decides to import this fruit. Farmers pick the fruit early in the morning. If not, it may fall and get bad. Penang Island is a good place to grow durian. The farmer tracks where each fruit comes from to keep it good for China. He does not want to sell the farm. He wants to grow new types of durians. He also hopes to have tourists visit the farm. Difficult words: import (to bring goods into a country), track (to follow), tourist (a person who travels to visit places). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

The Israeli military has claimed it killed Hezbollah leader Hassan Nasrallah in an airstrike on Beirut. The Israeli Defense Forces stated that Nasrallah would no longer be a threat to the world. The airstrike, which targeted Hezbollah’s headquarters, took place late on Friday. Nasrallah led the group for around 30 years and played a significant role in its rise to power. Reports indicate that other high-ranking commanders also died in the strike. Israel’s military chief noted that this attack had been planned for a long time and that they had additional tactics to deal with threats to Israeli citizens. The situation is tense, as Hezbollah hasn’t yet confirmed Nasrallah’s death, and there are concerns about possible retaliation . Many in Israel are anxious to see how Hezbollah will respond. The outcome of this situation could significantly affect the ongoing conflict in the region. Difficult words: high-ranking (having a senior or important position in a particular hierarchy), tactics (a carefully planned action or strategy to achieve a specific end), retaliation (revenge or response to an attack). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

The Israeli military says it killed Hassan Nasrallah, the leader of Hezbollah, in an airstrike in Beirut. The strike happened late on Friday, and it was meant to hit Hezbollah’s main headquarters . Nasrallah was the leader for about 30 years and was important for the group’s success. Some other top leaders also died in the attack. Israel’s military planned this operation for a long time, and they are prepared for more actions against anyone who threatens them. Many people are worried about how Hezbollah will respond. The group didn’t confirm Nasrallah’s death. This situation could change the ongoing conflict in the area. Difficult words: airstrike (an attack from the air), headquarters (the main office or center of operations for an organization), operation (an organized activity by a group of people). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

The Israeli army says it kills Hassan Nasrallah. Nasrallah is the head of Hezbollah for 30 years. He is a very important person. Thanks to him, Hezbollah is strong. The airstrike happens late on Friday in Beirut. Planes want to attack Hezbollah’s main office. Other top leaders of Hezbollah also die in the attack. The army says that Nasrallah cannot hurt people anymore. But now, Israelis are worried. Nobody knows what Hezbollah will do next. They do not confirm if Nasrallah is dead. This news can have an impact on the fighting in the area. Difficult words: airstrike (an attack from the air), confirm (to say that something is true or correct), impact (the effect or result of an action). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Dame Maggie Smith, the legendary British actress, has passed away peacefully in hospital at the age of 89. Known for her remarkable performances, she won two Academy Awards, one for The Prime of Miss Jean Brodie in 1970 and the other for California Suite in 1979. She is remembered for her iconic roles as Professor McGonagall in the Harry Potter films and the Dowager Countess in Downton Abbey. The UK Prime Minister, Keir Starmer, paid tribute, calling her a national treasure whose work will be cherished for generations. Maggie Smith’s family described her as a very private person surrounded by loved ones during her final moments. Many actors admired her talent, especially her ability to excel in comedic and dramatic roles. She was respected by younger actors despite her reputation for high standards and occasional sharp humor. Tributes continue to pour in, celebrating her outstanding seven-decade career in stage and film. Difficult words: iconic (famous and recognizable), cherish (to value deeply), excel (to be exceptionally good in an activity or subject). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Maggie Smith, a famous British actress, died at 89. She passed away peacefully in the hospital with her family by her side. Smith played in movies and TV shows and won two Oscars for her roles in The Prime of Miss Jean Brodie and California Suite. She was also famous for playing Professor McGonagall in the Harry Potter films and the Dowager Countess in Downton Abbey. The British Prime Minister called Smith a national treasure. Her family shared that Maggie was a private person, and they are very sad about her loss. Many actors admired her for her great talent in funny and serious roles. People are paying tributes to honor her long career in film and theatre. Difficult words: peacefully (calmly, quietly), treasure (something very special), tribute (showing respect or admiration). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Maggie Smith is a very famous British actress. She dies last week. She is 89 years old. She dies in the hospital with her family around her. Smith’s famous role is Professor McGonagall in Harry Potter and the Dowager Countess in Downton Abbey. She also wins two Oscars for her great acting. The British Prime Minister says that Maggie is a national treasure . People love her very much. Her family says that Smith is a very private person. They are very sad now. Many people remember her amazing work on TV, in movies, and in theatre. Difficult words: treasure (something very special), private (keeping things to themselves), remember (to think of someone who is no longer there). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Josep Borrell, the EU’s foreign policy chief, stated that the situation between Israel and Lebanon’s Hezbollah is almost a full-scale war. He described it as extremely dangerous, with civilian casualties rising and military strikes becoming more intense. Borrell warned that Europe’s worst fears of a conflict spilling over are becoming a reality. Civilians are paying a high price, and he urged the need for urgent diplomatic efforts to prevent a full-blown war. The ongoing Israeli airstrikes have killed over 490 people, including 35 children, and displaced many others. Israel’s defense minister said they will continue the attacks until northern Israeli residents are safe in their homes. Borrell has criticized the Israeli military response, saying that civilians are suffering an unacceptable price due to the conflict. He emphasized that this is the moment for global diplomacy to intervene and prevent the situation from worsening further. The potential for escalation remains a serious concern for Europe. Difficult words: diplomatic (involving the work of maintaining good relations between the governments or different countries), full-blown (fully developed), intervene (to become involved in a difficult situation to improve it), escalation (increase in intensity). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Josep Borrell, the EU’s foreign policy chief, said the conflict between Israel and Hezbollah is almost a full war. He explained that it is very dangerous. Many civilians are getting hurt or killed. Israeli airstrikes killed over 490 people, including 35 children, and many more had to leave their homes. Borrell criticized Israel’s actions. He said that civilians are paying a too high price. Israel’s defense minister said that they will continue the attacks until people in northern Israel are safe. Borrell called for urgent diplomatic talks to stop the situation from becoming a bigger war. He also said that Europe is afraid that the conflict may spread to other regions, which is already happening. Difficult words: airstrike (an attack by a plane), criticize (to say that something is wrong), urgent (very important), diplomatic talk (a formal discussion between people from different countries or businesses). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Josep Borrell is the EU’s top diplomat . He says that the fighting between Israel and Hezbollah is almost a full war. Many people die and many are hurt, including children. Over 490 people die. Many others have to leave their homes because of Israeli airstrikes . Borrell says that the attacks must stop. He asks for peace talks . He wants to stop the fighting from getting worse. Israel says they will keep attacking until their people in the north are safe. Borrell warned that the situation is very dangerous. The EU worries that more conflicts can start in other places. Difficult words: diplomat (an official who represents a country in another country), airstrike (an attack by a plane), peace talk (when two or more countries speak about ending a conflict or war). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

According to a study in Research Notes of the American Astronomical Society, Earth will have a second mini-moon from late September to late November. Environmentalists argued that increasing protected spaces is vital to protecting the country’s biodiversity, which is critical for tourism, air quality, and water supplies.
